mintAuthority.summary: mRe7YIELD is independently mintable on Ethereum and Etherlink: Ethereum authorizes two EOAs and a deposit-vault proxy, while Etherlink authorizes one shared EOA and its chain-local vault. Both EVM proxy paths use two-day timelocks, but the Starknet deployment is self-replaceable with zero delay through a single-key governance account, making the effective deployment-wide upgrade delay zero.

controls.label: mRe7YIELD Ethereum-only mint operator EOA
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; this role can call the token mint path directly.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE history and pinned state retained EOA 0x11e58b044b04eca3230c67217c482f24bdb90a72. Exact-block eth_getCode returned no bytecode.

controls.label: mRe7YIELD Ethereum and Etherlink mint operator EOA
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; this role can call the token mint path directly on both chains.
controls.evidence: M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE history and pinned state retained EOA 0xb755ff07fd80b38265ae35639568cfcdc874f21d at Ethereum block 25527148 and Etherlink block 48212139. Exact-block eth_getCode returned no bytecode on both chains.

controls.label: mRe7YIELD Ethereum and Etherlink deposit-vault minters
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; each vault holds the chain-local M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, vault proxy 0xce0a2953a5d46400af601a9857235312d1924ac7 held M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE and resolved to implementation 0xf80332996beb13c0693d79741d483d856a8a7327. At Etherlink block 48212139, vault proxy 0xbef85e71ecd0517d0c1446751667891b04860753 held the same role and resolved to implementation 0x0543efdb873b769aaf6443271e89859fe7e356e3.

controls.label: Midas mRe7YIELD EVM DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safes

routeChecks.signingModel: The Ethereum and Etherlink DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders are distinct chain-local 1-of-3 Safes with no enabled modules and zero guards.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: These Safes can immediately grant or revoke M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE. Their separate ProxyAdmin upgrade calls traverse two-day chain-local timelocks.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148 and Etherlink block 48212139, chain-local MidasAccessControl deployments granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 and Safe 0xdc208d4a8583663575fa548bf6de224bb5ffc26d. Both were 1-of-3, had no enabled modules, and had zero guards; the signer sets are chain-local and not represented as one shared Safe state.

controls.label: Midas mRe7YIELD EVM DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE histories and pinned state retained EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 on Ethereum and Etherlink. This authority can immediately grant or revoke M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on both EVM deployments.

controls.label: Midas mRe7YIELD deployment-wide upgrade authority

routeChecks.signingModel: Ethereum upgrades traverse a 1-of-3 Safe at 0xb60842e9; Etherlink upgrades traverse a distinct 1-of-3 Safe at 0xdc208d4a. Starknet governance account 0x04758595 is a single-public-key OpenZeppelin account.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Ethereum and Etherlink ProxyAdmin upgrades each require a 172800-second timelock. The Starknet replaceable class reports get_upgrade_delay() = 0, so deployment-wide effective delay is zero.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Starknet governance account currently has governance-admin authority and can register itself or another upgrade governor, then replace the token class without a waiting period.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148 and Etherlink block 48212139, all listed EVM proxies resolved through ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac to chain-local timelocks with getMinDelay() = 172800; their sole proposer/executor/canceller authorities were the chain-local 1-of-3 Safes. At Starknet block 11819111, mRe7YIELD used class 0x05ffbcfeb50d200a0677c48a129a11245a3fc519d1d98d76882d1c9a1b19c6ed, exposed replace_to(), and returned get_upgrade_delay() = 0. Governance account 0x04758595201d9d01be9f8bd232fe3a1c0b5c7b953219c9faa35779b3e73c214c had governance-admin authority and was a single-key OpenZeppelin account.

review.evidence: Deployment-complete audit at Ethereum block 25527148, Etherlink block 48212139, and Starknet block 11819111. Ethereum M_RE7_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holders are EOAs 0x11e58b044b04eca3230c67217c482f24bdb90a72 and 0xb755ff07fd80b38265ae35639568cfcdc874f21d plus vault proxy 0xce0a2953a5d46400af601a9857235312d1924ac7. Etherlink holders are shared EOA 0xb755ff07fd80b38265ae35639568cfcdc874f21d and vault proxy 0xbef85e71ecd0517d0c1446751667891b04860753. Both EVM access-control deployments retain EOA 0xd4195cf4 plus a chain-local 1-of-3 Safe as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. EVM proxy upgrades require two days, while the Starknet token class is immediately replaceable by its single-key governance domain, setting the effective upgrade delay to zero. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Midas publishes recurring NAV and reserve checkpoints through its Attestation Engine, with source notarization and independent LlamaRisk or Canary verification; this product retains its documented weekly reporting cadence. FMA prospectus approval is not issuer prudential licensing. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled direct mint or immediate minter-administration paths are economically unbounded; existing whole-supply periodic reconciliation and independent attestation evidence remain supported.
